FX-STROBE-001.says: The settings as they start: white, Copy, a strobe 0.1 seconds long every second. Frames 0, 1 and 2 (0 to 0.083 seconds) are white where the drawing is; frame 3 (0.125) is the drawing; frame 24 (1 second) is white again.

FX-STROBE-013.says: Copy in red with Blend With Original 50: halfway between the drawing and red.

FX-STROBE-014.says: Makes Layer Transparent: frame 0 is empty, frame 3 the drawing.

FX-STROBE-015.says: Makes Layer Transparent with Blend With Original 25: the drawing at a quarter strength.

FX-STROBE-016.says: Strobe Period 0.05, below the 0.1 duration: on at every frame.

FX-STROBE-018.says: Random Strobe Probability 50, seed 3, no regular strobe (duration 0, period 100): some frames strobe and some do not.

FX-STROBE-019.says: Random Strobe Probability 50, seed 4: a different choice of frames from FX-STROBE-018.

FX-STROBE-020.says: Random Strobe Probability 100: every frame strobes.

FX-STROBE-021.says: Blend With Original keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, Strobe Period 0.01 so every frame strobes: frame 2 is half strength, frame 4 the drawing.

FX-STROBE-023.says: After a drop shadow that grows the layer to 10 by 8, Copy in purple: the shadow is purple too, at its own alpha.

FX-STROBE-024.says: The layer starting at frame 2: its time counts from there, so frame 2 and 4 strobe and frame 5 does not.

FX-STROBE-025.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROBE-026.says: Strobe Duration -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROBE-027.says: Strobe Operator "screen", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROBE-028.says: Strobe "flash", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROBE-029.says: Strobe Color "white", which is not a colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STROBE-030.says: Random Strobe Probability keyed to 150 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
